bio_am: Ծնած է Ցղնա գիւղը՝ 1867-ին։ Հ. Յ. Դաշնակցութեան երեք հիմնադիրներէն մէկը։
bio_en: Rostom (Stepan Zorian) was born in 1867 in the village of Tsghna and studied in Tiflis at the Beglarian school and the state Realschule (1882-86); arrested for student unrest, he was exiled to his village, obtained a passport in the name of Abrahamian and joined the revolutionary circles in Tiflis, trying to run a secret press with Kristapor in 1887. After studying at the Petrovsky Agricultural Academy in Moscow from 1889, he became one of the founders of the ARF in 1890 with Kristapor Mikaelian and Simon Zavarian. For nearly thirty years he was the party's organiser and propagandist - in Trabzon in 1895, running a school in Philippopolis in 1901, in the Persian revolution in Tabriz in 1908, and opening the first free ARF regional meeting in Tiflis in April 1917. He was buried in Tiflis on 26 January, on the eve of the realisation of his dreams.
